svg.title: apply_rule in two moves
svg.desc: First, joint multiplies the two guesses for every pair; with A as 3 or 4 and B as 4 or 5, four pairs have chance. Second, each pair's chance is added into the bucket RULE of a and b: 3 plus 4 into 7, 3 plus 5 and 4 plus 4 into 8, 4 plus 5 into 9, giving 0.42, 0.46 and 0.12.
svg.text: each pair lands in its sum's bucket
